tasks.short: Schedule examinations, maintain records and archive images

steps.what: Schedule examinations or special procedures and resolve patient preparation and availability constraints
Maintain examination records and verify completed image identity and archive routing fields
Transfer completed image series into the designated clinical image archive
Check archive completeness, patient association and retrievability and resolve transfer failures

tasks.design: Configure native transfer between the examination record and image archive, represented by {OTHER}. Preserve scheduling, record verification and archive checking; automate only a separately observed manual transfer action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually transferring completed series repeats routing work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing imaging-system interfaces can transfer series and expose failures.
tasks.still_hard: A successful technical receipt may still conceal wrong-patient association or missing images.
tasks.human_edge: The sonographer verifies the clinical record against the actual examination.
tasks.altitude: Less transfer handling with unchanged scheduling and image accountability.

reach.task: Resolve an image archive identity discrepancy
reach.learn: Study identity, access and archive reconciliation

evidence.claim: Native image transfer with retained identity and completeness checks is an E1 design from model knowledge; the digest supplies no measured sonographer archive saving.

assumptions: Boundary is clerical booking, record maintenance and archiving, excluding clinical image acquisition, interpretation and specialist image-quality decisions.

The separately owned examination acquisition task produces completed images after s1 and before s2 through unchanged effort. Sonographer s2 captures or verifies patient identifier, accession number, examination identifier, study and series identifiers, expected series list, completion status and approved archive destination within20 hours.
Missing, conflicting or incomplete inputs stop transfer for manual reconciliation. S4 retains all receipt, completeness and retrieval checking; no free archive-ready flag is assumed.
Test native image transfer before custom code. If transfer is already automatic its runtime has zero labour baseline and this30-hour opportunity does not exist.
unknowns: Actual manual transfer effort, interface support and identity data quality
research_questions: Does native transfer reduce manual handling after counting all identity corrections, failed transfers and retrieval checks?

incremental.description: Archive exception review and transfer configuration checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gross30 minus5 focal upkeep gives net25. E1 manual-transfer scenario; more reconciliation reduces net to5-18. Already automated transfer yields no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise and train sonography learners and colleagues

steps.what: Supervise or train students and medical sonographers through observed scanning practice and feedback

tasks.design: Keep observed scanning instruction and supervision with the qualified sonographer. Methods in {DOCS} support the encounter; generic image software does not replace practical technique feedback.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technique and patient interaction require direct observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Administrative tools do not remove clinical supervision.
tasks.still_hard: A technically plausible image can be acquired with an inappropriate technique or incomplete examination.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor sees how the learner obtains images and responds to the patient.
tasks.altitude: Teaching responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Observed competence and specific corrective feedback

evidence.claim: Retaining observed sonography training and supervision is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is direct supervision and instruction, excluding course production, learner labour and independent diagnostic reporting.
No free structured competent or complete-examination flag is assumed.
Current guidance remains; no custom teaching tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
research_questions: Which acquisition errors only become clear through observing the learner?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; observed instruction and clinical supervision retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain supplies, order replacements and prepare special examination materials

steps.what: Check stock condition, quantities and expiry and identify necessary supplies
Select required supplies and capture purchase request fields
Populate the purchase request from the selected supply fields
Check supply suitability, quantity and delivery details and submit the purchase request
Prepare suitable supplies for special examinations and verify physical readiness

tasks.design: Configure request population in {PROCUREMENT} from sonographer-selected fields. Keep physical stock checks, selection, final request approval and examination preparation; no automatic reorder threshold is presumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected supply details may be entered again in a purchase request.
tasks.enabler_now: Native request templates can reuse selected catalogue and delivery fields.
tasks.still_hard: Stock condition and clinical suitability require physical and professional checks.
tasks.human_edge: The sonographer identifies unusable stock and inappropriate substitutions.
tasks.altitude: Less request re-entry with unchanged supply and preparation responsibility.

reach.task: Provide a complete, checked supply request

evidence.claim: Reusing selected catalogue fields in a purchase request is an E1 design from model knowledge, not a measured healthcare supply case.

assumptions: Boundary is sonographer stock checks, request preparation and special-examination supply preparation; procurement approval, supplier fulfilment and receiving labour are outside and unchanged.

Sonographer s2 produces item ID, description, unit, quantity, catalogue version, delivery location, required date and cost centre with capture included in20 hours. Missing or uncertain fields require manual request preparation.
Test native request configuration before code. Benefit requires actual duplicate entry; no free par level or structured reorder decision is assumed.
Existing stock or separately received supplies feed s5; if new supplies are needed purchasing and supplier fulfilment occur after s4 and before s5 with no assumed acceleration or labour transfer.
unknowns: Current duplicate entry and supply receipt responsibilities
research_questions: Does reuse reduce entry time after counting catalogue, unit and delivery corrections?

approvals.approved_version: Exact request items, units, quantities, delivery details and cost centre; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep gives net16. E1 duplicate-entry scenario; corrections can lower net to3-12 while physical stock and preparation time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform consent, safety-reporting and safeguarding duties

steps.what: Explain invasive procedures, answer questions and obtain and verify written patient consent
outputs: verified consent documentation or unresolved consent concern

steps.what: Prepare accurate safety or accident reports from observed events and checked facts
Recognise and report symptoms of abuse or neglect through the appropriate safeguarding route

tasks.design: Retain consent conversations, factual reporting and safeguarding judgement with the sonographer. Approved forms in {DOCS} support these separate event types; general consultation transcription does not establish a safe replacement for event reconstruction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consent and legal reporting need accurate context and professional responsibility.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates support completeness without establishing informed consent or reliable safeguarding judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A signature alone does not demonstrate understanding and suspected abuse can require sensitive escalation.
tasks.human_edge: The sonographer recognises uncertainty, checks understanding and reports facts responsibly.
tasks.altitude: Legal and ethical responsibility and time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Communicate observed concerns without unsupported conclusions

evidence.claim: Retaining consent, event reporting and safeguarding judgement is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary covers three alternative duty types, not a sequence requiring every patient to experience all three; shares describe the task mix.

Patient produces their consent response or signature during s1; sonographer verification remains counted. Sonographer supplies actual event observations in s2 and s3; no free informed-consent or abuse flag is assumed.
Keep existing approved forms and reporting routes; no custom tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; national consent and safeguarding requirements need confirmation.
unknowns: Applicable reporting routes, consent authority and safeguarding rules
research_questions: Which uncertainties require specialist consent or safeguarding advice before action?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; consent interaction, factual reports and safeguarding judgement retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated image transfer and purchase-request entry while preserving patient interaction and professional verification.
reach: Resolve archive identity issues with records administrators
Prepare complete requests for purchasing staff
role.ambitious_version: A sonographer who spends less time transferring data and maintains careful patient, archive and supply verification.
